text.tspan: Phase 1 — Site Feature Architecture · Free-Tier Build

text.font-family: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: KALT / SS Commercial Refrigeration. Feature set derived from docs/ia/SITE-SECTIONS-REPORT.md — the five-site audit of westernequipments.com, truemfg.com, beverage-air.com, traulsen.com and bluestarindia.com. Product taxonomy anchored to the Hoshizaki refrigeration catalogue.
Rev 2.0 2026-10-08 · Supersedes Rev 1.0, which described the same $0 topology without the feature map. Data model (HLD.md §7) and ADR-0001 'why PostgreSQL' (§8) carry over unchanged.

text.font-family: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: THE ONE PRINCIPLE — every page funnels to a single action: AN ENQUIRY. There is no checkout.

text.font-family: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Not one of the five audited sites publishes a price. Every path through every one of them terminates in "request a quote", "find a dealer" or "contact us". That makes the enquiry the only conversion event on the site, and it is the only write path that carries revenue — so it gets the outbox, the retries and the synthetic probe (§6), while everything else is a static file served from a CDN edge.
Read every box below as: what does this page need in order to produce an enquiry, and what does it cost to serve.

text.font-family: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Hosting constraint, unchanged from Rev 1.0 — Vercel Hobby forbids commercial use. Design on it, do not launch on it.

text.font-family: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Vercel Fair Use Guidelines, verbatim: "Hobby teams are restricted to non-commercial personal use only." A client's B2B lead-generation site is commercial use. Launch on Vercel Pro ($20/mo, no code change) or Cloudflare Workers ($0, commercially permitted, add @opennextjs/cloudflare — one day, once). Everything below is host-agnostic Next.js with no Vercel-proprietary API on a critical path, specifically so that stays a

text.tspan: 1 Image gallery 4-6 photos: closed · open and loaded · interior · controls · in-situ.
Plus a LINE DRAWING carrying the dimensions.
2 Model code + name As the H1. "HR-78MA-S · Reach-In Refrigerator, Two Section, Solid Door"
3 At-a-glance block capacity (litres AND cu ft) · temperature range degC · exterior W x D x H in MM
· doors/sections · refrigerant · power. Above the fold.
4 Primary CTAs [ Request a Quote ] [ Download Spec Sheet ] both above the fold. No price.
5 Cabinet construction exterior/interior material and GRADE · insulation type and thickness · door type
and reversibility · lock · shelves (count + finish) · castors · handle
6 Refrigeration system refrigerant + compliance · compressor type · defrost method · evaporator coating
7 Specification table 11 rows minimum, + 5 more for India -> panel, right
8 Downloads block 9 files per model -> panel, far right
9 Warranty Stated ON the page, not buried. True leads with "7-year parts, labour and
compressor" as a headline FEATURE, because it closes deals.
10 Accessories shelves · castors · drawer kits · door locks
11 Suitable for industry tags, linking back to the Industries page
12 Related models 3 cards — including the next size UP and the next size DOWN
13 Enquiry form inline at the bottom, model pre-filled. Writes to §6 step 2.

text.tspan: model number · exterior dimensions W x D x H · interior
· doors · shelves · net capacity · hinge location ·
voltage / frequency / phase 230 V 1-ph or 415 V 3-ph, 50 Hz
ambient / climate class rated for Indian summer
energy rating star label where applicable
UNITS: METRIC FIRST. Litres and mm primary, cu ft and inches
secondary. This is the single most common localisation failure
when copying the structure of a US site.

text.font-family: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace
text.tspan: NINE FILES PER MODEL (what Beverage-Air actually ships)
spec sheet PDF manual PDF brochure PDF
warranty statement PDF product video Revit / BIM
AutoCAD front .dwg AutoCAD plan AutoCAD side
Four of the nine is already strong. Omitting the spec sheet is
the single most common reason a B2B refrigeration enquiry never
happens — the purchase manager cannot put a web page in a tender.
All nine live in Cloudflare R2 and the page links them directly.
R2 egress is free at any volume, so the heavy bytes never touch
the host's bandwidth quota. Store per RANGE, not per SKU:

text.tspan: Why it is worth building, and how it stays free

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace
text.tspan: True is the ONLY one of the five with real faceted search
(/advanced-search). At 300+ model codes this stops being a
nice-to-have: a flat list is unusable, and a category grid alone
cannot answer "two-door undercounter freezer under 900 mm wide".
Facets are COLUMNS plus a GIN index, not a search service.
tsvector + pg_trgm behind the text box.
Filter state lives in the URL, so a filtered view is linkable,
ISR-render only the ~40 most common facet combinations; the
long tail resolves client-side against a ~60 KB static index.
A visitor filtering the catalogue never wakes Postgres.
SWAP POINT lib/search.ts -> Typesense when facet COUNTS and
typo tolerance are wanted. Same search(q, facets) signature,

text.tspan: Why the free tier costs you latency, not safety

text.font-family: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: The commit at step 2 is the durability boundary, exactly as in HLD.md. Steps 4-6 are best-effort delivery on top of a row that is already committed. QStash can be down, over quota or slow: the lead is not lost, it is late, and step 7 collects it. What the free tier costs is the worst-case notification latency — seconds becomes at most 15 minutes. What it does not cost is a dropped enquiry, and one lost
RFQ is worth more than a year of hosting.

text.tspan: 1 GB storage · 100 CU-HOURS/month · scale-to-zero after 5 min,
CANNOT be disabled · 10 branches · 6 h history · NO backups
THE BINDING LIMIT IS COMPUTE, NOT STORAGE:
100 CU-h / 0.25 CU = 400 h active per month out of 720.
Any poll tighter than ~15 min keeps it awake 24/7 = 1.8x over.
=> on-demand ISR only, a Redis-gated sweeper, and a filter UI
that resolves client-side. The DB sleeps between writes.

text.font-family: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace
text.tspan: ADD WHEN THE CONTENT EXISTS, NOT BEFORE
10 Dealer / network locator 4/5 of the sites have one, and
in India the dealer IS the buying channel. Blocked only on having
dealers to list. Promote it to v1 the day the list exists -- an
empty map is worse than no map.
11 Why Us / Technology Traulsen runs five such pages
ez-clean-gasket, ezclean-trayracks). Only worth building when the
claims are real and the test data exists. Invented
12 Installations / case studies HIGH VALUE, 1/5 convergence --
only Blue Star has it, which is the opportunity rather than a
reason to skip. A bakery owner seeing three bakeries you have
fitted out beats any amount of copy.
START PHOTOGRAPHING INSTALLATIONS NOW, before the page exists.
monthly for a year. Western's blog is the model: every post is a
product page in disguise, tagged to the product it sells. A blog
whose newest post is 14 months old actively damages trust.
recruitment, not customers. "Write to careers@" is an acceptable
v1. Do not let it compete with the product template for effort.

text.font-family: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace
text.tspan: LEAVE OUT FOUND ON WHY NOT
Serial number lookup True needs an installed base
4 separate warranty forms True one service form covers it
Parts e-commerce + tracking True, Bev-Air a whole storefront
Account login / cart Bev-Air no prices means no cart
"Build & price" configurator none 0 of 5 publish a price
Investor relations Blue Star not your obligation
Governance / group companies Blue Star conglomerate noise
Separate Sustainability page 3 of 5 a section inside About
Separate R&D / Factories 2 of 5 sections inside About
Separate press-release feed 2 of 5 one News feed
White paper library Traulsen needs real research
Video library page Bev-Air, Trau. embed on the product page
6 separate industry pages True (14!) one page, six anchors
Multi-slide hero carousel 2 of 5 slides 2+ are not seen
Horizontal-scroll showcase index.html §6 no sales function
THE RULE: every page ships with content on day one. Nine complete pages
beat twenty-five pages where eighteen say "coming soon" -- which is how
copying True's support tree would leave you.
ALSO CUT FROM THE CURRENT index.html (report §11):
§5 "build & price" CTA implies pricing -> [Request a Quote]
§6 horizontal-scroll section 420vh of scroll-jacking, no sales job
§7 "Try it for free!" CTA a SaaS pattern inherited from unox.com.
You cannot try a refrigerator for free.
§9 merge into §4 "choose by type" duplicates the rail
ADD a client logo strip missing, and the cheapest credibility
Net: thirteen sections -> ten. The page gets shorter and converts better.
